initial_application: The Jira comment recorded svn revision 5703. The imported git-svn commit c9dfce662e6f913b724c5a43d614e91b542869d8 is that revision and changed source/terminology-service.html from "a code must be defined somewhere" to "codes must be defined somewhere".

Zulip and Confluence searches found no directly relevant contrary discussion.
reconciliation: No source edit was made. The singular wording requested for correction is absent from the current build-scoped source, and the current wording preserves the approved pluralization while being more precise for current CodeSystem/ValueSet terminology.
